title: Stories open the afternoon
bea: “Stories first this time. I’ll bring one to open with. Thanks for finding a place for Dez’s workshop too.”
dez: “I can pick up a rhythm from the stories, if their tellers want that. Glad there’s room for both ideas next time.”
